info.name: E-Commerce Cart APIs
info.description: API collection for Cart Management - Add, Update, Remove, Get, and Clear cart items.

request.description: Get the current user's active cart with pagination. Product details and seller listing info fetched in real-time. For seller listings, includes sellerProductId, sellerId, seller's price/stock, and sellerDetails (sellerId, sellerName, sellerEmail). Response includes: userId, items (with productId, sellerProductId, sellerId, productName, qty, price, salePrice, totalPrice, gst, subTotal, images, stock, sellerDetails), status, timestamps, pagination metadata. Token required.

request.description: Add a product to the cart. Supports seller listings with sellerProductId and sellerId (optional). If product already exists, returns 409 error. Validates product/listing existence, approval status, and stock availability. For seller listings, uses seller's price and stock. Stores sellerProductId, productId, sellerId, productName, price, salePrice, totalPrice, gst, subTotal, images, stock, userId (from token), createdBy (user email), updatedBy (user email). Token required.

request.description: Update cart item with new quantity, totalPrice, gst, and subTotal. Validates userId (from token), productId, and stock availability. Automatically fetches user email and updates updatedBy field. Refreshes product details (price, salePrice, images, stock). Token required.
Remove a specific product from the cart. Validates userId and productId before removal. Updates updatedBy and updatedAt. Token required.

Delete the entire cart document for the user. Validates userId from token and user email. Removes all cart data including _id, items, status, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy. Token required.
